summary: The measured host passes a repetition count to the OpenMP row kernel. The worker loops each requested pass over assigned rows, visits every CSR nonzero, accumulates indexed products and writes output; its full body includes row and count control.

source_evidence.claim: Full source establishes runtime work extent, CSR setup, count-taking timed kernel and its repeated row computation.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock-bounded GOMP_parallel launch and complete outlined worker with repetition control, row/nonzero loops, product accumulation and output stores.
